description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapView' which renders an interactive mind map visualization for exploring role recommendations relevant to a persona, industry, skills, and salary filters. It includes functions for filtering roles, managing viewport state, fetching recommendations, and rendering nodes and edges of the mind map.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown array to an array of normalized strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a role object, handling various possible field names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title string from a role object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range fields from a role object to min and max in lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches the selected industry, skills, and salary range filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches recommended roles for a given persona ID.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts view state to viewport configuration.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport configuration and selected node ID to view state, including zoom clamping.
